title: 并行课程 III
summary: 课程有先修关系且可并行学习，求完成全部课程的最短月份数。
insight: 在 DAG 拓扑序上维护 finish[course] 为该课程最早完成时间。每条先修边 u→v 转移 finish[v]=max(finish[v],finish[u]+time[v])。
pitfalls: 无依赖课程从零月开始学习
多个先修课取完成时间最大值

solutions.title: 拓扑序最长完成路径
solutions.idea: 关键路径长度就是全部课程并行后的最短总时间。
steps: 建图与 indegree，入度零课程 finish=time 入队
弹出 course；对 next 更新 finish 并减入度，归零入队

code.java: class Solution { public int minimumTime(int n,int[][] relations,int[] time){List<Integer>[] graph=new List[n];int[] indegree=new int[n],finish=time.clone();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)graph[i]=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] relation:relations){graph[relation[0]-1].add(relation[1]-1);indegree[relation[1]-1]++;}Queue<Integer> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(indegree[i]==0)queue.offer(i);while(!queue.isEmpty()){int course=queue.poll();for(int next:graph[course]){finish[next]=Math.max(finish[next],finish[course]+time[next]);if(--indegree[next]==0)queue.offer(next);}}return Arrays.stream(finish).max().getAsInt();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumTime(n:Int,relations:Array<IntArray>,time:IntArray):Int{val graph=Array(n){mutableListOf<Int>()};val indegree=IntArray(n);val finish=time.clone();for(relation in relations){graph[relation[0]-1].add(relation[1]-1);indegree[relation[1]-1]++};val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();for(i in 0 until n)if(indegree[i]==0)queue.add(i);while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val course=queue.removeFirst();for(next in graph[course]){finish[next]=maxOf(finish[next],finish[course]+time[next]);if(--indegree[next]==0)queue.add(next)}};return finish.maxOrNull()!!} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int minimumTime(int n,vector<vector<int>>& relations,vector<int>& time){vector<vector<int>> graph(n);vector<int> indegree(n),finish=time;for(auto& relation:relations){graph[relation[0]-1].push_back(relation[1]-1);++indegree[relation[1]-1];}queue<int> pending;for(int i=0;i<n;++i)if(!indegree[i])pending.push(i);while(!pending.empty()){int course=pending.front();pending.pop();for(int next:graph[course]){finish[next]=max(finish[next],finish[course]+time[next]);if(!--indegree[next])pending.push(next);}}return *max_element(finish.begin(),finish.end());} };
